t: Games are Human Nature. Games are fundamental to humans, and we… | by George Pagoulatos | Medium
s: October 17, 2021 - Escapism is fundamental to humans, and you can only find it in the present, “The Now”. Social media apps to sports to music, humans look to escape their past insecurities, struggles, and future worries by being present in whatever they are consuming in The Now. Games are the predominate method young men use due to the competition, social aspect, and incredible stories that satisfy a niche for everyone.
